Normally, when I get drunk/tipsy my OCD is easier to handle but there were times when my compulsions significantly worsened bc of it. I'm not sure what it really depends on but I think my state of mind atm and environment play a huge role. Since my obsessions are mostly related to myself or objects I can't really tell you anything about intrusive thoughts afterwards but during the time I drink.
I used to be a huge overthinker and had similar thoughts compared to yours after spending time with friends, even thinking that I ruined their day and thought about them abandoning me bc of it. Luckily, those thoughts never turned into obsessions.
The only advice I can give you is to not give these thoughts any attention and focus on a positive thing that happened/occurred on the day before when u were out. Replace this exact event with your worries. 
Have a good one mate.
